text:
mia-partnerships: Quick sync 1: want to align Databricks Partner Connect + Snowflake Marketplace + first-class connectors for Pinecone/Qdrant/Weaviate. Keeping one launch quarter but staggered GTM assets.
ryan-partners: Agree. From partner ops: Databricks wants a Partner Connect repo + sample workspace. Snowflake will need a marketplace listing and a validated architecture diagram.
nate-eng: For Databricks we can bundle a small notebook + a wheels-based connector. Question: Partner Connect uses oauth flow. Do we need a proxy or direct customer token flow?
vince-databricks: Best practice is to use the Databricks OAuth app and short-lived tokens in-workspace. We'll share the sample app config.
tori-marketing: Heads up marketing asks: one marketplace tile blurb per platform, co-branded hero image, and a partner quote. Also timeline: assets 2 weeks before listing.
lila-privacy: Reminder: any listing must include a privacy snippet about telemetry, model input retention, and BYOK options. Also need to confirm whether connectors persist raw inputs in partner-managed vector DBs.
mia-partnerships: Good call. Action items: Nate: tech integration + sample notebook. Ryan: partner contacts and co-marketing commitments. Tori: blurb + hero image. Lila: privacy copy and short FAQ. Vince: Databricks config sample.
nate-eng: Tech note: prefer to offer two deployment options: 1) customer-hosted connector (recommend infra as code + minimal lambda) 2) Redwood-managed connector with explicit egress controls. We'll add runbooks for both.
ryan-partners: Legal will want revenue/marketplace fees noted. We'll need template clause that says "Marketplace fees are applied per host platform policy" and partner signoff.
tori-marketing: Can someone draft a 1-line tile for Databricks and Snowflake now? I'll iterate.
mailed snippet from nate-eng: ```sql
-- sample usage in Databricks notebook
from redwood_connect import Client
c = Client(api_key=dbutils.secrets.get("redwood", "api_key"))
emb = c.embed(["hello world"])[:5]
print(emb)
```
lila-privacy: Add to privacy: "Customers may opt-in to short-term request logging for observability; logs are purged after 30 days by default; BYOK options available for enterprise plans."
vince-databricks: We'll create the Partner Connect manifest and point to the public repo. Also recommend a quickstart workspace template.
infra-bot: CI pipeline triggered: `partners/connector-ci` -> staging matrix (us-east1, eu-west1) by nate-eng at 2026-03-12T09:00Z
mia-partnerships: Risk check: vector DB differences 1: Pinecone is managed, Qdrant & Weaviate OSS different APIs. We should provide a compatibility layer and clear docs on vector schema mapping.
nate-eng: I'll add an adapter layer in the SDK and a small test harness to validate embeddings+ids across DBs. Example test cmd: `pytest tests/integration/test_vector_end2end.py -k pinecone --region us-east1`.
tori-marketing: Webinar idea: "Connect your data platforms to Redwood inference" targeted to platform engineers. 30 min demo + 15 min Q&A. Plan for 2 weeks after marketplace listing.
ryan-partners: I'll confirm co-marketing commitments + PR windows with Snowflake and Databricks partners. We should avoid overlapping press days.
lila-privacy: One more: if customer data can flow to a managed vector DB, call out optional encryption-at-rest and customer-supplied KMS. No absolute guarantees.
mia-partnerships: Ok final checklist before next sync: - partner contacts locked - sample notebook + manifest - privacy FAQ - marketing tile + hero - CI test harness in repo. Meet weekly; I'll send calendar invite. Thanks all! :rocket:
